purpose: Teach: 柔道/忍者/空手/ご馳走/吹奏楽/剣道/スケッチ/リフレッシュ

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 論文、武道史、柔道と空手の比較、興味深いですね。
lines.en: Your paper on martial arts history — judo versus karate — that's really compelling.
lines.style: Warm, genuine attention. Opening cadence shows real interest. Steady eye contact. A teacher settling in to listen, not assess.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。忍者の文化的記述、別章で扱いました。
lines.en: Yes. I devoted a separate chapter to ninja cultural records.
lines.style: Slight relief in the voice — she's interested. Quiet confidence emerging. Brief pause before elaborating, like he's checking she's following.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 伝統行事のご馳走、地域文化の象徴ですね。
lines.en: The festival feasts are fascinating — they're really the heart of regional culture.
lines.style: Leaning forward slightly in tone. Affirmative nod in the voice. Building momentum, connecting the dots aloud with him.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 吹奏楽や剣道、現代の青少年教育に絡めて論じました。
lines.en: I wove in how band and kendo fit into modern youth education — made it all connect.
lines.style: Growing ease now. Clearer articulation. The thread of the paper becoming visible in his pacing. Still careful, but less guarded.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: スケッチによる現地調査、丁寧ですね。
lines.en: Your on-site sketching for research — that's meticulous work.
lines.style: Soft admiration. A beat of reflection, like she's genuinely impressed by the care he took. Slower pace here, turning something over.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 最終章は、武道家のリフレッシュ法、まとめました。
lines.en: The last chapter ties it all together — martial artists' recovery methods and rest practices.
lines.style: Completing the thought with quiet satisfaction. Slight exhale, like the arc of the paper feels whole now. Gentle closing tone.
